Open your device's web interface directly from SaltWatch Card. In the editor,
go to **Web interface → Enable shortcut**.

- **Tank only** makes the tank clickable. **Details only** adds an icon beside
  the status row. The complete card offers both.
- The shortcut uses the selected SaltWatch device's address from Home
  Assistant. **Web interface URL** accepts an override or a manual address for
  other water softeners.
- Use **Open with → Chromium Link** to access the device remotely through
  Home Assistant. That choice appears when Home Assistant has loaded the
  compatible integration and you are signed in as an administrator.
  [Chromium Link setup](https://github.com/thomasgregg/chromium-link#installation)
  · [Mincka Chromium app](https://github.com/Mincka/ha-addons/tree/main/chromium)
- The editor uses native Home Assistant switches, fields, and helper text.
  Tap, hold, and double-tap controls are grouped under **Actions**.
- Routine sensor updates refresh the existing card in place. The tank uses
  the established v0.6.3 renderer and sizing rules, with regression checks for
  narrow and fixed-height cards.

The shortcut is optional and off by default. Update through Home Assistant
Marketplace or HACS for your Home Assistant version. For a manual update,
replace the JavaScript and bump the version query on its dashboard resource.

[Installation and update instructions](https://github.com/thomasgregg/saltwatch-card#installation)
· [Shortcut configuration and YAML options](https://github.com/thomasgregg/saltwatch-card#web-interface-shortcut)
